units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 9:7">Nidd. IX, 7</cite> <he>וצריך לכַסְכֵּס וכ׳</he> one must scour with these substances three times.
<cite ref="Shabbat 141a:18">Sabb. 141ᵃ</cite> <he>מְכַסְכְּסוֹ מבפנים</he> he may rub the mud off from the inside. Y. ib. VII, 10ᵃ bot. <he>ובלבד שלא יְכַסְכֵּס</he> provided that he does not rub.
